revocable private capability. The processing receipt records the complete unique
selected read set. It has no observation, parent-audit, experience or archive resolver.

this is not a claim that every adapter closure is an epistemically restricted actor.

capability. Observer identity suffices for this accepted diagnostic refinement;
future character-state consumers still require accepted PRJ/IDN.

rows.text:
1. The earlier image builder and image review shared a wrong empty-list S0 assumption.
   Actual state restore rejected it. The [correct-forward correction](ATTENTION_INITIAL_STATE_CORRECTION.md)
   preserves all old bytes, leaves all 32 ModelIdentities unchanged, and recomputes
   224 specimen RunIdentities with the actual empty set of StateLeaf records. The
   [revision 2 cohort](campaign3-attention-model-rev2/FREEZE.json) is current. Old
   list-S0 run commitments remain historical and inadmissible, without aliasing.
2. Allocation counts alone do not prove output freshness. Runtime validation now
   extracts identity through the committed occurrence table and checks actual slots,
   including nested truth bindings/detections and the separately reserved experience.
   Reusing a well-typed selection ordinal fails and rolls back.
3. A valid parent edge alone does not prove child carriage. The independent trace
   validator reconstructs each producer's child payload from completed outputs and
   admitted input, including selected binding/claim copies. It also checks exact
   registered phase, event type and input schema. Reordered carriage and moving
   selection into recognition phase 20 are detected.
4. An apparently plausible receipt can omit a real read. The live consumer enforces
   complete, unique selected reads. Missing/repeated reads and shared-observation
   lookup faults reject. Selection and consumer state-clear faults also reject.
5. A suspected concurrent-reset defect did not survive inspection and substitution.
   The existing scheduler's `getPendingQueue()` rejects nonquiescent reads before
   private reset. Removing an experimental extra guard preserved both immediate and
   phase15 reentrant rejection. The redundant guard was removed; the regression test
   remains. This surviving substitution is not counted among the eleven detected
   faults, and no concurrency bug fix is claimed.
